title: HomePod Mini 2 in (RED) Seemingly Spotted Ahead of Announcement
summary: The rumored (PRODUCT)RED version of the HomePod mini 2 has seemingly been spotted on display at a few stores before it is announced. The speaker is expected to be released by Tuesday, December 1, which is World AIDS Day. The photo on the left was initially shared by X user @s_s_s_t_x and later reposted by Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman . The photo on the right was shared by Reddit user mateograph and reposted by MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris. As expected, this HomePod mini has a red mesh, and there appears to be a (RED) label on the box. No other changes are expected. Apple is expected to announce up to four other (RED) products next week, including silver-and-white AirPods Max 2 with a red Digital Crown, a red Wrist Strap for the AirPods Pro, a red Sport Band for the Apple Watch, and potentially a red AirTag 2 . Since 2006, Apple has partnered with (RED) to raise money for The Global Fund , an organization that aims to combat diseases such as HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria in Africa. Through this partnership, Apple had long offered a (PRODUCT)RED option for some products, but the color has not been offered for a while now . But, it appears Apple is reviving its (PRODUCT)RED line next week in time for (RED)'s 20th anniversary this year. Apple offered a variety of iPod, iPhone, and Apple Watch models in (PRODUCT)RED over the years, with some of the most recent products available in the color being the iPhone SE 3, iPhone 14, iPhone 14 Plus, and Apple Watch Series 9. A variety of iPhone cases, Apple Watch bands, and other accessories also came in the color.
